title: Rory and the Moonlit Riverbend
verses:
As the shadow fell soft on the velvet-green moss,
Little Psittaco chirped from a branch overhead.
Where the quiet stream rippled and glided across,
Nia fluttered to show them a shimmering bed.

Golden blossoms were blooming along the dark bend,
Gentle Tilly walked slow with a comforting stride.
Heavy Benny was pleased to arrive with a friend,
Where the pale moonlit water could sparkle and glide.

Friendly Rory stretched out on a carpet of blue,
Sturdy Ricky rested his chin on his paw.
All the leaves were washed clean in the cool evening dew,
Filling hearts with the peacefulest wonder and awe.

Tiny Psittaco nested in Rory's green crest,
While sweet Nia tucked down by the moss on the ground.
Safe and cozy, each friend was now ready to rest,
As the night breathed a gentle and lullaby sound.

Benny let out a sigh that was grounded and deep,
Tilly settled beside him and closed up her eyes.
All the dinos were ready to drift into sleep,
Under blankets of blue in the velvet-soft skies.

Now the river flows soft as the night rolls away,
Whispering peace to the forest so deep and so still.
They will dream until morning brings back a new day,
As the breeze settles over the slumbering hill.
